limits.en: Unlimited layers, thousands of vector/raster/live brushes, motion presets, free forever

keyLimits.en: $34.99/month for first 3 months then $69.99/month; bundles 20+ Adobe apps, not a Fresco-only paid plan

cautions.en: Fresco itself has no standalone paid tier; premium features come only through a full Creative Cloud Pro subscription, which is a much larger purchase than the app alone.

capabilities.en: Thousands of raster, vector and 'live' brushes that behave like real paint/ink media
Frame-by-frame animation and motion presets to add movement to illustrations
Symmetry tool for mirrored strokes and Paint Inside to constrain color to enclosed areas
Cross-device syncing between mobile and desktop for a project

limitations.en: No paid standalone plan; unlocking anything beyond the free app requires a full Creative Cloud Pro subscription
Desktop support limited to Windows (no native macOS desktop version mentioned)

reason.en: Leading iPad digital painting app, one-time purchase versus Fresco's Creative Cloud model.
Popular illustration/comic app competing for digital painting workflows across platforms.
Free, open-source digital painting alternative to Fresco.

unknowns: Whether a native macOS desktop app exists (only Windows was mentioned for desktop) not fully clarified
Exact scope of features unlocked specifically by Creative Cloud Pro versus other Adobe plans not itemized on this page
